text: Google acquired Wiz to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure, positioning itself for what it viewed as the next battleground in the "cloud wars" [Source: ev-1]. This was underscored by the transaction's scale—approximately $32 billion in an all-cash deal—and its status as the largest acquisition in Google’s history [Source: ev-1]. Additionally, the fact that Wiz had previously rejected Google's earlier $23 billion offer in July 2024 before agreeing to the higher price suggests significant competitive tension and high valuation standards within the sector during that period [Source: ev-1]. The agreement was announced on March 18, 2025, with completion reported in July 2025 after regulatory steps were completed [Source: ev-1].
